behavior: Repeated SSH authentication failures consistent with password guessing.
insufficient_evidence_conditions: Failures without success evidence do not establish account compromise.
A disconnect event alone does not establish a successful login.
investigation_steps: Verify incident source events and their original Event IDs.
Review the SSH authentication timeline and its time window.
Correlate source IP, destination IP, account and SSH process.
Check whether repeated failures originate from one or more sessions.
Search separately for successful authentication evidence.
Classify observations, unsupported claims and missing evidence.
recommendations: Review affected account and SSH access policies.
Consider rate limiting, MFA or access restrictions after analyst review.
Escalate if independent evidence of unauthorized access is found.
title: SSH Brute Force Investigation
